company.name: Teleo
company.shortDescription: Teleo provides construction equipment by converting existing fleet into remote-controlled robots.
company.description:
Teleo specializes in converting existing fleet into supervised autonomous robots. It enables operators to control machines from miles away, instantly switching between machines and across job sites.

Teleo increases the operator's productivity, enhances crew safety, and features advanced Jobsite insights.

productsAndServices.description: A system that retrofits heavy construction equipment to enable remote control and semi-autonomous operation, allowing one operator to manage multiple machines from a remote command center.
productsAndServices.name: Teleo Supervised Autonomy

productsAndServices.description: A hardware kit that can be installed on any make, model, or year of heavy equipment to enable remote and autonomous operation capabilities.
productsAndServices.name: Teleo Universal Retrofit Kit

productsAndServices.description: A centralized control facility where operators remotely manage multiple Teleo-equipped heavy machines using joysticks and monitors.
productsAndServices.name: Teleo Remote Command Center

productsAndServices.description: Software that enables remote control, autonomous functions, and operational analytics for Teleo-equipped heavy machinery.
productsAndServices.name: Teleo Proprietary Software

productsAndServices.description: A communication network that connects Teleo-equipped machines and the remote command center to enable reliable data and control signal transmission.
productsAndServices.name: Teleo Robust Mesh Network
